definition: Cosmopolitan means drawing on many cultures and at ease among them.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word cosmopolitan. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know cosmopolitan should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Years of crewing on cargo ships had made the cook cosmopolitan, as ready with a Manila breakfast as with a Marseille stew.
Open-minded says you welcome unfamiliar ways when they arrive; it stops short of cosmopolitan, which has gone out and lived among them.
Well-traveled goes further than open-minded — the stamps and the miles are real — but it stops short of cosmopolitan: miles prove motion, not ease among the cultures they pass through.

Worldly means experienced in the ways of the world — money, motives, how deals really get done — sometimes at the cost of innocence. Cosmopolitan is warmer and more particular: shaped by many cultures and at ease among them. A worldly person is hard to fool; a cosmopolitan one is hard to make feel foreign.

International describes things that span nations — treaties, airports, agencies — and is said of organizations and undertakings more than of a person's temperament. Cosmopolitan describes the person or place itself, drawing on many cultures and moving easily among them. A firm can be international while every manager in it has never felt at home abroad.

A suitcase full of stamps proves only movement; cosmopolitan describes what the moving made of you.

Trieste's station buffet has been run since 1978 by Rosa Marchetti, who grew up above it speaking four languages before she was ten.
Sailors, students, and pilgrims order in whatever tongue they carry; Rosa answers in kind, and remembers how each culture takes its coffee.
Guidebooks call the buffet the most cosmopolitan room in the city, a judgment Rosa earns table by table.
Her nephew, who has flown to forty countries on business, admits the difference: he has crossed more borders, but she is at home in more worlds.
Nothing foreign stays foreign at her counter for long — a welcome that miles alone have never taught anyone.
